title.narrative: Central African Republic COVID-19 Preparedness and Response Project

description.narrative: The purpose of the COVID-19 Preparedness and Response Project in the Central African Republic is to prepare for and respond to the threat posed by COVID-19 (Coronavirus). This project consists of three components. The first component is preparedness and response. This component will finance activities related to activities pertaining to preparedness, case management and response, including procurement of medical equipment and supplies, risk communication and community engagement, including capacity building and coordination. Component two is project implementation. Implementing the proposed project will require monitoring and evidence generation, reporting and impact assessment. Component three is Contingency Emergency Response (CERC). In addition, a CERC will be included for situations of other urgent need of assistance or capacity constraints.
To prepare for and respond to the threat posed by COVID-19 in the Central African Republic.
